title:
A type to store the batch outputs for a {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJob}.
Note that each batch stores
- A list of {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s to be validated.
  From the list of models the asset relations are deduced using {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel#currentAssetRelations}.
- A list of {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation}s to be validated.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobBatch
